argv: SELECT CASE WHEN d.file_id IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(d.file_id AS TEXT)) END AS "file_id",CASE WHEN d.string_pool_id IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(d.string_pool_id AS TEXT)) END AS "string_pool_id",CASE WHEN s.string_idx IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(s.string_idx AS TEXT)) END AS "string_idx",CASE WHEN s.value IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST(s.value AS TEXT)) END AS "value" FROM dex_files d JOIN strings s ON s.string_pool_id=d.string_pool_id ORDER BY d.file_id,s.string_idx
